text: Safety integrity: safety instrumented functions shall be classified by the SIL determination (LOPA or risk graph) with the target of the functions in the risk criteria; the SIL-rated functions (burner management, gas station shutdown, LDO trips, ammonia unloading interlock, fire and gas) shall be verified for the achieved PFDavg with the proof test intervals and shall not be less than SIL 1; the HAZOP recommendations and their close-out shall be tracked in the HSE-in-design register (HS-PLN-0001).
